Uzbekistan offers 30-day visa-free stay for select Indian citizens

Uzbekistan has introduced a 30-day visa-free entry policy for Indian citizens holding specific valid multiple-entry visas. To avail this, travelers must possess a confirmed return or onward air ticket. The Indian Embassy in Uzbekistan announced this facilitation, which follows discussions with the Uzbek President.
